acceptance_criteria.statement: AC1 Auto-remediation uses shared environment apply lock.
AC2 auto_apply invokes the desired-state deploy helper.
AC3 approval_required marks remediation_needed and waits for authorized remediation.
AC4 Failure metadata and backoff are stored.
AC5 No fake external control-plane events are synthesized.

rollout_gates.gate: Observe_only remains the default rollout mode.
Auto_apply enabled only after lock-contention and failure metadata tests pass.

rollback_criteria.criterion: Change reconcile_mode to observe_only or disabled.
Clear scheduled auto-remediation workers after lock contention drains.
